motivation: Distinct mapped within-species Pleistocene break LOCATION outcome, not Fst/He/COI magnitude; hypothesis and source panel were prospectively frozen 2026-10-29.

source_geometry.true_break_cases: fixed 10km sampled published Pleistocene break lines within author surveyed polygons
source_geometry.backgrounds: fixed 20km surveyed grid >50km from mapped break and capped 1000/species with original SHA rule; availability only

source_feature_rules.geographic_barriers: source-reconstructed mountain major river/lake level I/II ecotone TRI, not exact original author extracted CSV

model.baseline: four current climate bio vars + sqrt 4 reconstructed barrier distances + log1p(TRI) + geographic lon and lat
model.species_equal_case_background_weight: all species equally weighted; within species cases and backgrounds split 0.5/0.5
model.fit: scikit-learn LogisticRegression C=2 solver=lbfgs max_iter=150 tol=1e-5 random_state=0
model.statistic: species-equal mean heldout AUC difference with+history minus baseline
model.bootstrap: 1,999 species cluster replicates; seed 20261029; two-sided 98.33% interval quantiles 0.008333333333 and 0.991666666667
model.sensitivity: retrain the same frozen baseline and augmented models on the single pre-frozen 50km jittered case-site features; same original backgrounds and original observed case labels; one 98.33% species cluster CI
model.no_claim_of_robustness_unless_sensitivit: If original positive but jitter lower CI includes zero, label the primary signal POSITION_SENSITIVE_NOT_ROBUST, never a stable positive
model.if_original_primary_nonpositive: close as NO_QUALIFIED_ADDED_HISTORY_LOCATION_PREDICTION with sensitivity reported descriptively; no retuning or subgroup rescue
